# `SB_URL_ARG_UNENCODABLE`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Storybook (`SB_`)](README.md#domain-sb) |
| Reported by | `planner` |

## What happened

In URL-fallback mode an arg value cannot be encoded in the URL; the variant was skipped.

## What to do

Drop `--no-channel` (or use a build where the preview API works), or limit values to letters, digits, space, `_` and `-`.
